question.text: Post pre-clearance under PIT Schedule C, trades must be executed within:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Pre-cleared trades must be executed within no more than 7 trading days, else fresh pre-clearance required. **The Trap:** Shorter/longer windows misread the rule. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same 7-day rule in III-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Expire pre-clearances automatically in the PIT tool on day 7 to force fresh approval.
